esencial.description: For condominiums with up to 40 apartments.
features: 3 loaned IoT devices (1 4G gateway, 1 water point and 1 energy panel)
Non-invasive installation: no water or power cuts
5 loaned IoT devices (1 4G gateway, 2 water points and 2 energy panels)
Monthly reconciliation against Sedapal and Luz del Sur bills
Cent-exact legal proration and digital settlement per unit

gran-torre.description: For towers with more than 80 apartments.
features: 7 loaned IoT devices (1 4G gateway, 3 water points and 3 energy panels)
Monitoring of multiple cisterns, panels and elevators
Anomaly detection and reconciliation with master bills
Aliquot proration with an exact 100.0000% balance
Preventive maintenance and periodic sensor calibration
